item.title: Human skeletal remains found outside of Conetoe
item.description: EDGECOMBE COUNTY, N.C. (WNCT) -- The Edgecombe County Sheriff said skeletal human remains were found outside of Conetoe on March 18. Officials said that deputies are working the crime scene on US 64 Alt. No other information has been released at this time.
